description_en: Calls GetClassRecord to retrieve class recording information. You can use this operation to obtain the playback URL after a class ends. If the class has not ended, the result is empty
description_zh: 调用GetClassRecord获取课程录制信息。可用于课程结束后获取回放地址，如果课程未结束，结果为空
kebab_example: aliyun imp get-class-record --app-id lq0000cu --class-id AE350000T95F --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetClassRecord

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the class, returned by calling CreateClass
parameters.help_zh: 课程唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回
parameters.name: class_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator. The value can contain only letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 操作人用户ID，仅支持英文字母和数字，长度最多36个字符
parameters.name: user_id

Result.description_en: The response struct of the API request
Result.description_zh: API请求的返回结果结构体

PlaybackUrlMap.description_en: The collection of playback URLs. The key indicates the playback video type. Valid values: m3u8, mp4, and flv. Currently, only the m3u8 type is provided
PlaybackUrlMap.description_zh: 回放地址集合。key值代表回放视频类型，取值m3u8, mp4, flv，当前仅提供m3u8类型

Result.title_en: API请求的返回结果结构体。
Result.title_zh: API请求的返回结果结构体。
